message.content:
**Time difference (current):**  
Berlin is **9 hours ahead** of Los Angeles.

**Why?**  
| Location | Standard Time | Daylight‑Saving Time | Current offset (Sept 2026) |
|----------|---------------|----------------------|----------------------------|
| Los Angeles (Pacific Time) | UTC‑8 | UTC‑7 | UTC‑7 |
| Berlin (Central European Time) | UTC+1 | UTC+2 | UTC+2 |

Both regions are observing daylight‑saving time in September, so the offsets are UTC‑7 and UTC+2 respectively, giving a 9‑hour difference.

**Note on seasonal variations:**  
During the brief overlap when the U.S. has already switched to daylight saving but Europe hasn’t yet (or vice versa), the difference can temporarily be 8 or 10 hours. However, for most of the year—including now—Berlin is 9 hours ahead of Los Angeles.
